item.title: Rove 0.1.3
item.description:
More data, clearer choices.
Open more NEXUS state-label exports and inspect labels, constant characters and uncertainty before running. Complete state labels can define the character alphabet when you explicitly choose them. True polymorphism remains unsupported for inference.
Analyze aligned DNA from FASTA or NEXUS with JC69, or combine one morphological matrix with one DNA alignment. Review taxon matching and choose a fixed or estimated morphology-to-DNA rate ratio. The combined model shares its tree, clock and gamma shape; HKY and GTR are not available yet.
Inspect the rooting split and the clock-sigma prior curves. Yule is now an optional pure-birth prior for contemporaneous species, with a configurable birth-rate bound. Birth–death remains the default, and fossil dating keeps FBD.
Review sampling, agreement, trees and predictive evidence together in History. Paired posterior predictive plots help you inspect discrepancies. Export supporting files with a manifest and choose whether to include the original matrix.
An optional joint topology/rate proposal is available for undated relaxed-clock analyses, with weight zero by default. This is partial ORC coverage; the full BEAST operator suite and comparative performance validation remain pending.
Reopen the original thank-you letter from Help → A thank-you to Thiago, just as you can revisit the tour and What’s New.
Keep the previous app to resume checkpoints created by its engine. Completed results remain in History. Existing 0.1.2 installations can receive the signed update; 0.1.1 needs one manual DMG installation.

item.title: Rove 0.1.2
item.description:
More control over your analysis, more ways to open your results, and updates that come to you.
Choose intermediate or custom sampling plans and run up to 16 independent chains. Set comparison burn-in, execution options and relaxed-clock sigma priors in the app.
Open external trace files, import completed CLI runs with matrix verification, and estimate model evidence directly from Review. Trace diagnostics accept burn-in in samples as well as percentages.
Check for signed updates from the Rove menu or Settings. Installation waits for active calculations to finish.
Upgrading from 0.1.1 requires one manual DMG installation to add the updater. Keep the previous app if you need to resume checkpoints created by its engine; completed results remain available in History.
